children: Australian shares were set for a weak open on Friday, on track for a fourth consecutive day of losses on potential declines in mining stocks, while surging oil prices keep investors focused on the prospects of domestic monetary policy tightening.
The local share price index futures (YAPcm1) slipped 0.9%, an 86.4-point premium to the underlying S&P/ASX 200 index
close. The benchmark fell 1% on Thursday.
